passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.text: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.text: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Tough It Out
spells.text: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.text: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.text: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

damage.value: Olaf deals true damage with Reckless Swing and sustained damage through increased Attack Speed.

archetype.value: Olaf is a stat-checking diver who looks for chances to run targets down.

axis.value: Olaf pushes slower lanes with Tiamat and looks for all-ins when an opening appears.

winCondition.value: Olaf farms heavily, pushes waves, and takes towers, treating kills as a bonus.

spikes.why: Olaf can use Q, R, and Ghost to run targets down.
Olaf can push waves and pressure towers.
Olaf resets Undertow's cooldown, allowing another throw sooner.

bait.why: Olaf cannot throw another axe during Undertow's cooldown unless he picks up the axe.
Olaf cannot deal Reckless Swing's true damage again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Olaf makes a mistake by forcing fights in difficult ranged lanes instead of trading farm and surviving.
Olaf loses opportunities by forcing fights instead of surviving and trading farm when an all-in is unfavorable.
Olaf misses a chance to reset Undertow's cooldown when he does not pick up the axe.
